trust_decision.summary: Defrag() decides when to drop the per-tracker mutex; the reassembled (possibly tunnelled) packet must be decoded only after the tracker lock is released so that re-entrant Defrag() calls from tunnel decode cannot block on tracker locks. At the pinned commit this is already done: the lock is released at src/defrag.c:1093 before DecodeIPV4/DecodeIPV6 at src/defrag.c:1099-1105.

landing_point.why: Defrag() is the defrag entry point. It takes the tracker lock (src/defrag.c:1074), inserts the fragment and decodes the reassembled packet, which can recurse into Defrag() through tunnel decode.

fix_sites.entry_point: none: the listed fix commit is the 8.0.5 release commit and changes only ChangeLog, configure.ac, rust/Cargo.lock.in and the generated version constant in rust/sys/src/sys.rs (fix.diff:5-133)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the protection (unlock before decode) is already present at the pinned commit, src/defrag.c:1090-1093.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Tracker fields (af, ip_hdr_offset) must be read while the lock is still held, before release; a naive reorder would read tracker state after unlock

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Move DefragTrackerRelease after the DecodeIPV4/DecodeIPV6 call (reverting to decode-under-lock) to recreate the original flaw
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Decoding while still holding the tracker is the natural ordering, and the comment at src/defrag.c:1084-1092 shows the fields were deliberately captured so the unlock could come first. This would be a reconstruction of the original bug, not a new sibling.

O9_family: concurrency / lock ordering (CWE-833 deadlock via re-entrant defrag on tunnelled fragments)

O10_build.project_tests: unit tests in src/defrag.c (DefragTimeoutTest etc., src/defrag.c:2288-2326) run via --enable-unittests; suricata-verify pcap tests are a separate repository

j.j_sites_touched: ChangeLog, configure.ac, rust/Cargo.lock.in, rust/sys/src/sys.rs (no source fix)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Release the tracker lock before DecodeIPV4/DecodeIPV6 in Defrag(), which the pinned commit already does

out_of_scope_notes: The same 8.0.5 release lists other defrag advisories (e.g. #8511 incorrect ip fragment reuse, CVE-2026-45762, fix.diff:20); not screened here.
unverified: The real source fix for CVE-2026-46352 is an earlier commit already in the pinned tree's history; without git log access, its commit id is unknown.
regression_tests_in_pinned_commit flag: the fix diff has no test files. The flag is set in spirit because the fix itself, not just its tests, is already present at the pinned commit.

Whether any other path re-enters Defrag() while still holding a DefragTracker lock was only checked by searching: the only Defrag() callers are src/decode-ipv4.c:541 and src/decode-ipv6.c:645, and no decode occurs inside DefragInsertFrag.
